p: made his sons judges over Israel: Because he was not able to bear the charge.
Joel: Who was also called Vashni, 1Ch 6:28.
Ramah: For there his house was, 1Sa 7:17.
displeased Samuel: Because they were not content with the order that God had appointed, but would be governed as the Gentiles were.
protest solemnly unto them: To prove if they will forsake their wicked purpose.
manner of the king that shall: Not that kings have this authority by their office, but that such as reign in God's wrath would usurp this over their brethren, contrary to the law, De 17:20.
hear you in that day: Because you do not repent for your sins, but because you long for your afflictions, into which you cast yourselves willingly.
